summary: E2E frontend testing of the Production Confirmation split (operational page cleanup + new Confirmed Production reporting page). All acceptance criteria PASS. Operational tab correctly stripped of KPIs/History/Export/last-confirmed filters; all 8 operational controls present and interactive (Refresh and Manage Reasons verified). New /production-confirmation/confirmed-report page renders correctly with title, all 6 filters + Refresh + Export Excel + Clear-Filters buttons, table with 44 rows of real confirmation history returned by backend (site enrichment + uom enrichment present). Site dropdown populates from /api/store-requests/known-sites (9 sites: All + P1, P2, P2W, P3, P4, P7, P8, P9). Clear Filters button correctly hidden when no filters active and shown after typing. Export Excel button correctly disabled when visibleRows==0. By-product and WIP filter changes re-fetch without error. Production nav dropdown shows all 3 required items in correct order and mobile Production accordion also lists Confirmed Production. No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile viewport. No page errors on any of the 4 /production-confirmation tabs. Backend endpoint GET /api/production-confirmation/confirmed-report smoke-tested via curl: returns {rows:[...]} with main_output_product_description + uom enrichment fields, only success=True history.

issues: main_output_product_description is null for every row returned by the backend right now, so the Description column is universally '—'. Not a fork-session regression (endpoint is unchanged this session), but flag to E1: enrichment lookup may not be finding descriptions - worth verifying against SAP Product master. All 44 rows have description=null.

critical_code_review_comments: ConfirmedProductionPage.js is clean and self-contained (~230 lines). No _id leakage, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, error state handled, loading Skeleton shown, all interactive elements have data-testids.
Minor: exportToExcel passes formatUnit(r.uom || undefined) - the `|| undefined` is redundant, formatUnit already handles falsy. Cosmetic, not a bug.
Minor: Description column showing '—' for every row (backend enrichment returns null main_output_product_description for all history rows) - not this session's scope but worth investigating.
